groups.title: Experiment 01: Maya, diversity attribution
groups.line: One-year lives of Maya in four conditions that vary the outcome dice, the opening order, both, or neither.

groups.title: Maya showcase
groups.line: Maya's first lives, before experiment 01; run 1 is from before the message and spend tools, so it isn't comparable with the rest.

groups.title: Self, Track A
groups.line: Self's first life: two years in the student world.

groups.title: Experiment 02 part A: Self as written
groups.line: Two-year lives of the base Self persona in the student world, one per seed.

groups.title: Experiment 02 part B: Self, one change at a time
groups.line: Four versions of Self, each with one change to the persona or the world, on the same seeds as part A.

groups.title: Experiment 03: Self in world v3
groups.line: Self in world v3, where it can deploy a static site, invest its savings, go full time or decline offers, on the same seeds as part A.
